corridor.name: I-78 Western New Jersey (Warren / Hunterdon)
corridor.study_limits_note: Study section per the INRIX pull: I-78 from the PA-NJ state border (Delaware River, MP 0) to Charlestown Rd / Perryville Rd (Exit 12), about 13.5 miles per direction, Warren and Hunterdon counties. The crash extract currently covers only Greenwich Twp (Warren) and Bethlehem Twp (Hunterdon), about MP 3.7 to 10.4; Pohatcong Twp (MP 0 to 3.7) and Union Twp (MP 10.4 to 13) still need to be pulled.

corridor.note_on_zones: Zones follow the CDOT convention (interchange to interchange, adjusted for grade and visibility features). Grades, mile posts and the zone split at the Jugtown summit are placeholders until NJDOT SLD / LiDAR profile data is loaded.

climate.source: NOAA GHCN-Daily via NCEI Access Data Service

classes.label: Heavy rain (>= 1.0 in at any station)
Freezing precipitation / black-ice risk (precip with Tmin <= 32 F, snow < 0.5 in)
Light snow (0.1 to < 1 in at any station)

gaps: GHCN-Daily has no visibility, fog, wind, or pavement-temperature fields. Fog / low-visibility exposure needs hourly ASOS (Lehigh Valley Intl KABE is the nearest first-order station) or NJDOT RWIS feeds.
Daily totals cannot resolve time of day; hour-of-day overlap with traffic comes from INRIX speeds and the crash time stamps.
Temperature comes from only two COOP stations (Phillipsburg, Flemington 5 NNW); the ridge top on Jugtown Mountain is likely colder than either.

inrix.source: INRIX TMC 5-minute speeds and travel times, 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31, 24 TMC segments

crashes.source: NJDOT crash tables (Crash, Vehicle, Unit) filtered to route 78; municipalities in the extract: Bethlehem Township, Hunterdon, Greenwich Township, Warren
caveats: Extract is by municipality (Greenwich Twp, Bethlehem Twp) so I-78 coverage runs about MP 4.0 to 11.2; Pohatcong Twp (MP 0 to 3.7) and Union Twp (MP 10.4 to 13) are not yet included.
Only route-78 mainline records are used (1008 of 1595 rows in the extract); ramp and crossroad crashes are excluded.
Adverse = surface Wet/Snowy/Icy/Slush/Water or weather Rain/Snow/Fog/Sleet/Freezing rain, following CDOT Chapter 3.1.1.
Truck-involved = any unit coded as a truck type or GVWR > 26,001 lbs.
Secondary = a crash in the same direction within 2 h after, and 0 to 3 mi upstream of, an earlier crash (time-of-day and milepost based, so an approximation).
Person-level fields are not used; no personal identifiers are carried into the dashboard.

workzones.expected: NJDOT lane-closure / permit log or OpenReach work-zone events for I-78, with start and end time stamps, direction, mile posts and lanes closed. Interim proxy: crashes coded 'Construction Zone' in the crash extract.

continuous.label: All crashes per day on continuous weather drivers
